digest.component_or_area: Configuration composition and ownership enforcement (RP-04 epic)
propositions: A deterministic AST ownership gate must reject all direct and aliased environment/credential reads outside approved composition roots, failing with path, symbol, and access kind diagnostics.

The ownership registry must map every declared configuration and credential name to exactly one approved owner seam, with legacy exceptions being exact, shrink-only, and empty before contract-phase closure.

Generated configuration, security, and operator documentation must be byte-current with schema and ownership registries, covering lifecycle, precedence, restart, observability, subprocess, and behavior deltas.

Legacy facades, migration switches, and ambient reload paths must be deleted only after focused suites and bounded live canaries pass, with rollback capability retained to the S1 snapshot-envelope floor.
Structural change-detector tests must validate that synthetic prohibited access forms, unowned registry names, glob exceptions, and expired migrations all fail the gate while approved fixtures pass.
